# GitHub Copilot Instructions

This repository uses comprehensive AI assistant guidelines documented in the root-level `AGENTS.md` file.

## Quick Reference

For complete instructions on working with this codebase, please refer to [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) which includes:

- Project scope and goals
- Tech stack and runtime requirements
- Build, run, and test commands
- Code quality standards and linting rules
- Git workflow and commit conventions
- CI/CD expectations
- Documentation requirements

## Key Commands

- **Build**: `dotnet build VideoConverter.sln`
- **Format**: `dotnet format`
- **Test**: `dotnet test`
- **Run**: `dotnet run`

## Important Notes

- Always run a successful build before completing any task
- Treat warnings as errors
- Maintain ≥85% code coverage for new/changed code
- Follow Conventional Commits style
- Update README.md when changing user-facing behavior
